pageTitle: Participate — send field reports and corrections to Ethotechnics
pageDescription: Send a field report, a correction, or a public failure the casebook should score. What to include, where it goes, and what happens to it.

hero.heading: Send evidence, corrections, and cases.
hero.description: The standards change when someone shows where they are wrong or where a system broke them. This page says what to send and where it goes: one inbox, hello@ethotechnics.org, or the public repository.

panel.title: Records over opinions
panel.description: A decision log, a postmortem, or a tribunal ruling changes a clause faster than an argument does. Say what the record shows and what changed for the people it affected.

pathways.title: Send a field report or case
pathways.description: A postmortem, research memo, or public record showing a delegation that held or failed. A case established by a court, an inquiry, or a regulator can be scored in the casebook.
checklist: Say what the system decided, and for whom.
Attach the records you can share: decision logs, notices, rulings.
Say what changed for the people affected, if anything did.

actions.label: Email your field report
actions.ariaLabel: Email your field report to hello@ethotechnics.org

pathways.title: Commission a review
pathways.description: Reviews of governance plans and deployed systems are paid work, done by Ethotechnics Studio. Lessons from a review are published only with your agreement, and anonymized.
checklist: Send the plan or draft you want reviewed.
Name the decision you have to make next.
Mark anything that must be anonymized.

actions.label: Email Ethotechnics Studio
actions.ariaLabel: Email studio@ethotechnics.org to request a review

openSource.title: Work in the open
openSource.description: The site, its content, and its data live in a public GitHub repository. You can file an issue, propose an edit, or read the data directly.

items.title: Repository

intake.title: Draft the email here.
intake.description: Fill this in and your mail app opens with the message written. Nothing is sent from this page.
intake.formatNote: Links, PDFs, slides, or a short write-up all work.
intake.responseNote: The draft is addressed to hello@ethotechnics.org.
intake.timelineNote: Nothing you send is published without your agreement on scope and anonymization.
intake.privacyNote: What you type stays in this browser until you send the email yourself. Leave out personal details about anyone else.

feedback.title: Found something wrong?
feedback.description: Say what is wrong, unclear, or missing: a broken link, a clause that cannot be tested, an example you needed and could not find. A substantive critique gets a written answer saying what changed, or why nothing did.
